title: Public Sector Banks to Operate on Sunday, September 27, 2026, Ahead of Strike
content:
# Public Sector Banks to Operate on Sunday, September 27, 2026, Ahead of Strike

Ek important update hai for all bank customers! Government ne Public Sector Banks (PSBs) aur Regional Rural Banks (RRBs) ko Sunday, September 27, 2026, ko operate karne ke liye announce kiya hai, amidst an upcoming bank strike.

Here's what you need to know:

*   **What's Happening:** All Public Sector Banks and Regional Rural Banks will function normally today, Sunday, September 27, 2026.
*   **Why:** This proactive step has been taken by the Ministry of Finance to ensure that the genuine banking needs of the public are not adversely affected for an extended period.
*   **Background:** The United Forum of Bank Unions (UFBU) ne September 28 se 30, 2026 tak teen-din ki nationwide bank strike call ki hai. Since September 26 and 27 weekend holidays hain, ye strike 5-din ki continuous banking disruption create kar sakti thi.
*   **RBI Approval:** Reserve Bank of India (RBI) ne bhi approval de diya hai for all bank branches, offices, ATM-linked branches, and Currency Chests to remain fully operational on September 27, 2026.
*   **Ministry's Stance:** The Department of Financial Services under the Ministry of Finance ne reiterate kiya hai that the welfare and convenience of bank customers remains the government's foremost priority.
